quest.title: In the Shadows of Night
quest.description: Ever do ominous mists rise at night, and ever will perilous schemes brew in the darkness...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1550, Primogem x30, Mora x68175, Hero's Wit x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x12

chapter.num: Song of the Welkin Moon: Act I
chapter.title: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here, bucket bucket bucket... Where are you hiding?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Judging from the concentration of kuuvahki... over there.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Wow! You can sense that, Lauma Doe? That's incredible...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Let's move the recon bots above them out of the way first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How come you're here by yourself, Lauma? Where's Jahoda?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I haven't seen her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously? Don't tell Paimon she's ditched us on our first mission together...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I don't believe so. Nefer and I have our differences, but that shouldn't interfere with our shared objective.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Recovering the relic is my duty — but as far as she's concerned, there's plenty to gain here too.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: In Nod-Krai, it's common knowledge that the Curatorium has a nose for profit and opportunity... the same way aphids flit from flower to flower in a neverending quest to make honey.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Sounds like you know her pretty well...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, Jahoda sure is taking her sweet time...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: ...I believe we may have misjudged and underestimated Miss Jahoda.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What do you mean?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: As a... former employee of the Curatorium, I'm confident that she possesses both professionalism and integrity in ample measure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? What was that noise?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: The sound of a wavering conscience, perhaps?
Aah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, something just fell down!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Ahaha... Hi—Hello everybody!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What kind of an entrance is that!? Wait a second... Have you been hiding nearby this whole time?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Uh... Y—Yeah! I was just, uh... scouting things out from up high!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (Darn it...! How did Jane Doe even notice me up there?)

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (*sigh*... Can't believe I only realized I'd run out of smoke bombs this morning... What if something goes wrong inside? How am I supposed to make a quick getaway now...?)

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (Thought I could just hang back and wait for the clients to get cold feet, but nope... Turns out they're all completely fearless! Don't they know how scary the Fatui are!?)

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Um... Really sorry, everyone... Truth is, just as I was heading out this morning, I discovered I'd run out of a super important, completely essential, absolutely indispensable piece of equipment...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... So, what are we gonna do?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Hehe... Well, as I see it, there are two options!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Plan A is... We take a detour to Nasha Town to restock. Though who knows if any shops will still be open this late...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Plan B is... We call it quits right here, disband the team, and all go home! My place is only, like, a ten-minute walk from here, so...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Personally, I vote Plan B! Bada bing, bada boom! Maximum efficiency, minimal effort!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't try to solve your problems by running away!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Neither of those "plans" sound great...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Not a fan of either? Then I guess our only option is to fall back on Plan J — that's J for Jahoda, by the way!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Why didn't you just tell us that was an option in the first place?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: C'mon, that would've totally ruined the surprise! Boss pulls this trick all the time, and it's always the clueless ones who end up praising her to the skies...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Feels like you just threw shade at a whole lot of people...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I have faith in your professionalism, Jahoda. You don't need those flashy tricks — your abilities alone are more than enough to earn our respect.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (Huh, this Jane Doe sure has an eye for talent... Speaking of which, maybe it's time I started calling her something nicer?)

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Hehe... You really mean that, Ja— I mean, Lauma Doe?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I do.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Tell you what, it's not every day you get to work alongside such considerate clients! I have a feeling we're gonna make a great team!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Plan J is this: we find our way in through the freight access on the facility's east side!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: It's tucked away from view, and security's lighter at night. I've prepared some special gadgets too, so we should be ready for anything.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: If we want this to go without a hitch, we'll need to work together every step of the way — so everyone, stick close behind me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that finally sounds like a real pro talking...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Hey! You saying I didn't before!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Kinda, yeah...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: You...! Ugh... Never mind. A top-tier treasure hunter like me never lets the naysayers get to her...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Alright, let's go over what we agreed on yesterday...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: The goal of infiltrating the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau is to locate and, if possible, recover the relic that the Fatui stole.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: We also need to figure out why they built the facility in the first place. I'm worried that they've set their sights on the Ancient Moon's Remnants on Hiisi Island, too.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Well, now that we've got a plan, time to get this show on the road..

choices.text: (...And that's exactly why there's a rift between them.)

talks.objective: Talk to Jahoda once you're ready

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: Yes... and in your final moment of hesitation, I... took the chance...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...And then you gave it to the Fatui!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... when we talked to you before, you seemed so genuinely worried about Lauma...

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: Because I... I thought she was as fed up with the Frostmoon Scions as I was!

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: We grew up together, Lauma. I know you were chosen to be the next Moonchanter when you were just a child. They never gave you a choice in that.

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: I saw the look in your eyes when you were treating that child... that sense of helplessness. Surely you, too, must see that this blind, inherited faith of ours is simply holding us back...

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: If our prayers are never answered... then why keep praying? Do they really deserve all of your devotion?

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: Or... are you trapped by the responsibilities they imposed on you?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: So those are your reasons for wanting to leave the Frostmoon Scions?

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: Isn't that reason enough!?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: *sigh*... When we pray to the moon, we do so to show our gratitude for the life it granted us long ago. It reminds us to strive for something higher within ourselves...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: But I know that's not what you want to hear. You're right, Vilemina... I have indeed kept secrets from you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Lauma...)

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: I knew it... You don't want to be the Moonchanter, do you...?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: No, that's not it. I'm talking about the fact that the moon in the sky isn't real.

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: What...? Y—You're saying... Huh?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (Ugh, I've completely lost the thread now... but do we really have to do this here? What if a Harbinger shows up... I'm not cut out for fighting big bosses!)

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: The pain you sensed in me... was the pain of hiding this truth.

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: If what you're saying is true, then you already knew that the Frostmoon Scions wouldn't believe any of this... Why didn't you just leave, like I did?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: You don't understand, do you? That's the difference between us, Vilemina — I care about the Frostmoon Scions. They're family to me.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: It hurts because I care... and that's why I chose to hide the truth. But now I understand — that was a mistake.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: My family deserves to know the truth. I shouldn't have tried to hold it all together with empty prayers...

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: Hah... Are you trying to say that I only ever cared about myself?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: There's nothing wrong with that, in itself. No one would have tried to stop you from leaving... but you did not have to stab us in the back like this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...We've been spotted!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (I knew it, I just knew it! Ugh, what now!? If a Harbinger shows up, I'm outta here. No darned relic is worth dying over!)

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: ...Looks like I misjudged you, Lauma. I didn't think you had it in you to stand up to your fate.

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: Turns out... you are a great Moonchanter, after all.

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: But you were right about one thing — I haven't considered Hiisi Island my home for a long, long time now.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Bosses, time to go!

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I will change the Frostmoon Scions, Vilemina... as soon as the new moon rises.

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: ...Then I guess I won't be around to see it.

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: Say, Lauma — what happens to those who betray the Frostmoon Scions?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: "...May their antlers be shorn with silver blades... and let them be cast into the long night of unknowing."

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: Ugh... Ahhh... Aaaaagh!!!

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: ...I have honored the ways of the Frostmoon Scions, one last time... Think of it as a gesture of respect, Lauma.

response.speaker: Talvikki
response.text: There they are!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lauma!

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: Marionette has the Moon Marrow... She went to Starsand Shoal.

response.speaker: Vilemina
response.text: Don't... flatter yourself, now — I'm not trying to "atone." I just... don't believe you'll actually be able to change them...

talks.objective: Infiltrate the Fatui Experimental Design Bureau
Infiltrate the Fatui Experimental Design Bureau

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Just as I thought, there's a gate controlling access from the outside. Good thing I brought this key card, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Well, technically I stole it... but no need to tell them that, right? Blame that chump who thought it was a good idea to get wasted at The Flagship during work hours...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Is it top-level clearance?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Course, that goes without saying! Let me read it out for you...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Fatui Experimental Design Bureau No. 183574, maximum clearance... "Maintenance Intern."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...That doesn't sound very top-level to Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Never underestimate interns! Even the most legendary of thieves started out as rookie pickpockets, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Besides, if it wasn't for this person's selfless generosity, we wouldn't be able to just waltz in like this, would we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Feels like you're trying really hard to change the subject...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ahem... Allow me to teach you the first rule of treasure hunting...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: "First and foremost — use every resource at your disposal!"

talks.objective: Choose a suitable route to continue your infiltration

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Ahh, I get it now. It's like a pair of lightbulbs just lit up in my head...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... What did you just "get"?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The blue light, aka Plan A, is telling me to take the path along the left side. It'll be a lot stealthier, but that might mean a bit of a detour.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The red light, aka Plan B, is saying: "Just charge straight in!" But that'll mean dealing with... like, a dozen sentry bots already powering up.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Although... I might be able to switch them to "training mode." Their attacks will be weaker, but we'll still be in for a fight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can't you just put them in "sleep mode"...?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hey, I told you I'm just a Maintenance Intern! Give the new recruit some time and space to blossom, will ya?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Hmm... We're still pretty close to the entrance. Surely they'll call the whole thing off once they see what these bots can do?)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Anyway, I say we go with Plan B. Either way, I won't be doing any of the fighting, so... the shorter route sounds good to me!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: If we can avoid fighting at this stage, we should.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No Plan J this time?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Plan J... is to call it a night so we can all make it back to bed before sunrise! After all, the deeper we go, the more dangerous this is gonna get — so we might as well give up while we still can!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Okay, you're the bosses...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Just don't forget — whatever you do, don't let those recon bots spot you!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Let's see... Huh, no kidding! Ineffa told me about something like this before. Can't believe that dumb robot actually helped me out for once...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: All you gotta do is... this, and the recon bots will be reassigned to another position.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: That way, when it's time to move forward, the path will be clear! Which reminds me, it's about time I taught you the third rule of treasure hunting...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: "Go with the flow!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What about the second one? You skipped that one...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Huh, did I? Oh jeez, I must've gotten them muddled up again...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: ...I—I mean... the second rule is exactly the same as the first!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess that's what you meant by going with the flow, huh...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Well, alright then.

talks.objective: Choose a suitable route to continue your infiltration

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hey! There's someone up ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Snjezana
dialogues.text: Has the lockdown been initiated? Move it, soldier — the cargo has already been transferred.

dialogues.speaker: Siemomysl
dialogues.text: The lockdown procedure is complete, commander. That sector is now fully sealed.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Tch, the night shift... Just our luck. Don't they usually handle deliveries during the daytime? There's not supposed to be anyone here...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (We've come this far already, and they're really trying their best... If I suggest backing out again, it's not gonna look good. Come on, brain, think!)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Ah, I've got it! The freight shaft to the upper levels... We might have a shot there.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Let me see... Huh? The recon bot in the middle's not responding? ...A double-lock failsafe!? Ugh, we've been outfoxed!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Stay calm, stay calm... One step at a time. Let's just find a way across first...

talks.objective: Operate the terminal and head to the entrance of the freight shaft

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do we do now? There are guards here too...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Don't worry, bots are way easier to deal with than people. At least their behavior is predictable.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: First, let's find a safe spot to land... Good, that spot shouldn't draw their attention. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Let me just try something... Mmm... Maybe I can use the terminal to command them to move out of our way...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Security verification? With ten questions!? Are you kidding me!?!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: You really trust me that much? Ugh, fine... I'll... do my best.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: But just to be clear — if I can't answer a question, I'm backing straight out of the terminal. No way I'm risking triggering any sort of alarm...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's fine. You've got this.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (Come on, Jahoda... You can't give up now!)

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Question One... "What is our motto?"... Oh, I—I know this one...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Question Five... The name of the Harbinger in charge of this facility... Let's go with... "Sandrone."

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: This one should be... The "Palestar Edict." I've heard one of Boss's informants mention that before...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Final question... Enter employee ID? And it's timed!? Okay, okay... 183574... Confirm!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: I... actually got them all right!? What a miracle...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Not bad, Jahoda, not bad at all! Guess you're an official Maintenance Intern now, hehe...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Hey, that could be my personal "Plan B" if I can't get my job back... Hehe, just kidding... The Fatui are awful.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: The bots have taken the command... they're moving off. Let's get going while the coast is clear.

choices.text: Don't waste your energy. Let's just fight them.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Are you serious?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Of course. I can beat them.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: #(Doesn't {M#he}{F#she} trust me? Or is {M#he}{F#she} just trying to make things easier for me?)

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: #(No... Judging from {M#his}{F#her} body language, {M#he}{F#she} really isn't afraid of the Fatui. What kind of person is {M#he}{F#she}... and what has {M#he}{F#she} been through?)

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (So brave it's kinda scary...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Jahoda?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Uh... N—No complaints from me! Let's... I mean, you go for it!

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: *sigh* Then let's make this quick.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Didn't think they'd even cut off the supply of kuuvahki... They're being really cautious.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If we can somehow divert some emergency power into the system, we might be able to force boot this thing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you mean by "force boot"?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Uh, how do I explain this... It's like... dumping a whole bucket of water into an empty pool? So that... the little ducky gets to swim around again?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You should probably just ask Aino instead...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So we just need to find that bucket of water, right? Paimon thought your explanation was great! Kinda adorable, in a childish sort of way.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hey, you could've just skipped that last part!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Everyone, ready? Yeah? Then, let's move.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Alright then, let's get this job done!

choices.text: I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: No rush, we'll be waiting right here. Just don't go sneaking home on your own, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Is this what you were looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That's right, that's exactly what we needed. Where did you find that?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I sensed kuuvahki inside it during the fight just now. They must've been using it as backup energy for their armor.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I honestly had no idea that fighting could solve so many problems... Darn it, why am I so weak?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oops, did I say that out loud? Ahaha, just, uh... ignore me...

talks.objective: Use the charging device to activate the freight shaft
Go to the upper levels of the Fatui Experimental Design Bureau

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's so dark in here...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Well, it is a cargo crate, after all. No point being picky about lighting at this point...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whaaa! Something sharp and pointy just poked me in the back...!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Ah... Sorry, that was probably just my antlers. It's pretty cramped in here, so I had to crouch down...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Having antlers must be inconvenient at times like these...
Zzzzt!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaah... What's going on!?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Don't tell me something's gone wrong already!?)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ahem... Looks like there was only enough juice in the emergency power supply to lift us this far up...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Ugh, awkward... Am I gonna get docked for this? Based on the boss's policy of docking pay for every screw-up, I'm— No, wait a sec... I've already been fired...)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Doesn't look like it's moving again any time soon.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I—I think... we can get through if we follow the ventilation duct along the outer wall... The entrance has gotta be somewhere. Don't worry, this was... totally part of the plan!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh!?
Clang!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jahoda!? How'd you end up outside?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Looks like she slipped out at the very last second, just before the gate shut. Impressive reflexes, I must say — though I'd expect nothing less from a former employee of the Curatorium.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'm so sorry! That was pure survival instinct... I didn't mean to ditch you!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Anyway, you guys just stay where you are. I'll... I'll figure something out...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hey, there's a terminal nearby. Hang tight!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Can you hear me now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Loud and clear.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The duct's security protocol has been triggered... The gate must've dropped when it detected a living presence.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so... we're trapped in here!?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'm checking what I can do from this end... Ah, watch out for the laser up ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What laser...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We see it now... Good thing we didn't move.

choices.text: I don't think we can jump up right now...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Got it... I think I understand the situation! Hang in there, just one moment...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: ...Ugh, this is killing me, but I think I've got it. I can try adjusting the direction of the kuuvahki flow inside the duct.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: If I've got this right, you might just be able to dodge the lasers by utilizing the kuuvahki's pull in reverse!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Paimon thinks she gets what you mean.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: But I can't see where you are from here, so I'll need your constant input. Just tell me what to do — I'll follow your lead.

choices.text: We're being held down by the kuuvahki.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We made it to the other side, and all thanks to Jahoda!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... But the gate hasn't opened... How's she gonna meet up with us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jaho-daaaa...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: "No irregularities detected in the duct." "Confirm." "Confirm." "Confirm."

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ugh! Just confirm the command already, you... useless excuse for a terminal, you piece of robo-junk, you... mindless pile of scrap!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: What the... Insufficient clearance!? Of course I don't have the clearance, you oversized—

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Urgh!!! ...Ouch...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Go with the flow, Jahoda, go with the flow. If the others make progress, that's great — but you can't bank on it. You've never been one to depend on others... so it's about time you stepped up to the challenge.)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Deep breaths... Stay calm.)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (My priority right now is getting my hands on a high-level access card. That way, I can override the security protocol.)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Senior maintenance staff... Only they can access the core sector. But hey, there's always someone careless enough to hide a spare key under the flowerpot by the door...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Which means... there's a good chance there's a duplicate lying around somewhere in the control room!)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Even if I can't get into the control room myself, doesn't mean I can't rely on some external help! If I can take control of one of those guard bots, maybe I can use it to search for the access card!)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: This is crazy, Jahoda... You're all alone, you've got nothing, and yet you're charging ahead like fear's a foreign concept...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Haha, maybe that's exactly why — 'cause I've got nothing left to lose!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: "Confirm!"

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Am I... a genius?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whoa, this feed's super clear... This is gonna be a piece of cake!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Wait a second... This thing's not a guard bot, it's a...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...Janitor bot!?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: There it is...!

dialogues.speaker: Talvikki
dialogues.text: Hey, why'd you stop? You haven't finished sweeping that corner!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (But... I can see the card from here...!)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Ugh... Guess I have no choice but to swallow my pride and stay in character for now...)

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: Ugh... Lost them again...

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: #(That Harbinger... told me to follow the {M#blond}{F#blonde} Traveler who might visit the Frostmoon Scions...)

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: (*sigh*... Easier said than done, though. The animals are on alert at night... If they see me, Lauma will catch wind of what I'm doing, sooner or later...)

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: (...Am I really doing the right thing?)

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: (No... It's too late to turn back now. The empty prayers, the stubborn displays of faith, like Kapy's today... This isn't the life I want.)

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: #(Huh? Is that... Ah! {NICKNAME}'s back! I won't let {M#him}{F#her} slip away this time!)

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: #(Wait. Who's that with {M#him}{F#her}? They look so alike... Hmm, they seem to be heading... towards the statue of Kuutar!)

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: (They've... opened the secret chamber!? But... wasn't it meant to be sealed?)

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: Wait a second... the Moon Marrow!

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: (Surely they're not after the Moon Marrow!? I'd better go report this straight to...)

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: Hold on...

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: (If they do actually make it to the final room... then maybe I'll be able to get my hands on the relic... the one thing the Fatui have been after this whole time...)

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: (If someone's going to take it, it might as well be me... This could be my ticket to joining them!)

talks.objective: Use the high-level access card to activate the terminal

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But will Jahoda be okay?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Paimon!?)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: She said she'd use every resource at her disposal, so let's have some faith in her abilities. Besides, when it comes to surviving in Nod-Krai, she probably knows more than any of us...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (So they really do believe in me...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But how long are we gonna have to stay here? Paimon doesn't wanna get caught by the Fatui either...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Does Paimon mean the two Fatui in that room? Let me see if there's a way to distract them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Wait, did you hear that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't move.

dialogues.speaker: Talvikki
dialogues.text: Huh? The alarm? What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Prohor
dialogues.text: Let's go check it out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Now's our chance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This looks like somewhere important, but there's nothing here...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hey guys, it's me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jahoda! Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'm fine!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I managed to swipe a high-level access card and triggered an alarm to draw the guards off... But we don't have much time.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Alright... Looks like we can control the elevator!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Come on, hop in. Let's take it further down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's no one here!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That's good news for us! Let's head inside.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Looks like a rest area for the Fatui's Oprichniki.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh? The terminal's still on...?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ahaha... Looks like that "good news"... is now half good news, half bad news...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Well, seems like that alarm I just triggered was so high-level that even the guards in the rest area went to investigate... that's the good news, by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then what's the bad news?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The bad news... is that once they realize it was a false alarm, they're bound to circle back and check this floor, and then we're toast!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: So we've gotta move fast here! If you need me to run a quick search, say the word.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: "...Analysis of the kuuvahki extracted from the Moon Marrow suggests that its energy core bears some close relation to the power of the former Three Moon Sisters..."

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: "...It is suspected that there is a link between the Frostmoon Scions' hidden relic and the shattered remnants of the Eternal Moon..."

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: C'mon, none of this is important right now... Just tell us where you hid the darn thing!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: "Access denied. You do not have permission to view this data."

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Even with a high-level access card? Who does have permission then!?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Looks like that's about all our current clearance gives us access to...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Based on what we know so far, it seems like the rest must be hidden inside that massive hollow beneath us...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I could sense something beneath the water down there... something unsettling.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If they've gotten their hands on the Moon Marrow, odds are it's hidden down there too.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (Ugh... and here I thought we were almost done. But nope, we're going deeper and deeper into the danger zone...)

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: (Chin up, Jahoda! Once this job's done, you're buying yourself the biggest Nod-Kraian hot dog in town. Deal's a deal!)

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Good idea! Pulling it right away...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Whoa... What's with that huge hollow structure down below?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: That might just be it. Secluded, out-of-the-way... exactly the sort of place they might be keeping the relic.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Two hundred and sixty-four pages... What is this, a novel!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can we just skip to the end?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: I'm flipping through as we speak! Kuuvahki... A "weapon"...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Huh? Seems like the Fatui in Snezhnaya are trying to harness the power of the Light Realm to build some kinda weapon... the target of which is...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Seriously? Insufficient clearance, again!?

talks.objective: Solve the mechanism and shut the fan off

dialogues.speaker: Maciej
dialogues.text: ...What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Vanamo
dialogues.text: I'm not sure. Seems like the Moonchanter has something important to tell us...

dialogues.speaker: Kunegunda
dialogues.text: I heard the relic's already been retrieved.

dialogues.speaker: Lauha
dialogues.text: That's our Lady Lauma, alright!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: *deep breath*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Do what you believe is right, Lauma...)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Noble scions of the Frost Moon... My kin beneath the moonlight...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I hereby declare the truth to you...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: "Long have our ancestors looked up to the Frost Moon, guided by her serene light... Yet now, she lies hidden beyond the limits of the sky."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And so, Lauma began to reveal to the Frostmoon Scions a truth long hidden within her heart... A story of a false moon, and the death of gods...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: "Kuutar was indeed born of the moon... but that does not give us the right to reap without sowing, nor clothe ourselves without the toil of weaving..."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As she spoke, some who listened were stunned into disbelief, while others... seemed to awaken, as if from a dream.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: "...From this day forth, the road shall be paved with truth, and we shall pave it ourselves."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... After everything Lauma said last night, Paimon wonders how everyone's adjusting...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, we're here to find out...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, judging by their reactions at the time, it didn't seem as intense as Paimon might have imagined... Says a lot about how much trust she commands, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look — it's Lauma!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Welcome, both of you. The animals were most lively this morning... They told me of your coming.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Has everything been okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nothing too dramatic happened, did it? No one took it so hard that they went on a binge eating rampage, and ended up cleaning up the whole pantry... or something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The only person who would do something like that is you, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Paimon's just trying to lighten the mood...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Thank you for your concern.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Change doesn't happen overnight, and new ideas need time to take root... But nothing as extreme as that has happened, no.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Although...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A—Although what?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Well... Just as I thought might happen, some have chosen to leave the Frostmoon Scions for good. For them, losing their faith was like losing their home.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Confusion, frustration, helplessness... I saw it all, reflected in their eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I respect their choice. May they carry the Frostmoon Scions' blessings far and wide — should they be willing to do so.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: If we meet again someday, perhaps we will be able to sit together and share stories once more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hope everything goes well for them...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Others sought me out afterward, though... and thanked me profusely for sharing the truth with our people.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: They said they used to see me as "distant," even somewhat unapproachable... Whereas now, I seemed much closer to them — like a friend, or even a family member.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like a win overall! Paimon thinks you did the right thing, Lauma.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Though, I wanted to ask...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Do I really come across as... "distant"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Well... maybe just a little, to people who don't know you? You are kinda tall... especially if you consider the antlers...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: That's a bit of a hard one... My antlers tend to grow under the moonlight, so I can't quite help it.

choices.text: Just be yourself. No need to act any different...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: It brings me comfort to hear you say that.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}, how has your body been adjusting to the Moon Marrow?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm feeling absolutely fine.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I'm glad to hear it. I've also suggested to Nefer that we meet within the next few days. We need to figure out how to counter this new manifestation of the Wild Hunt.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: But for now... let's just relax.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I want to enjoy this feeling a little longer... of finally living on the bright side of the moon.

choices.text: Family should be honest with each other, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: That switch looks... suspiciously obvious. No way I'm pulling that! But you guys, go ahead...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you spotted it first! Shouldn't you be the one to pull it?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Not a chance! I'm just the guide, remember? At most, I'll help you look for an escape route...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (They don't seriously think pulling this thing's gonna lead to treasure, do they? I'd be amazed if it doesn't set off an alarm...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Besides, I didn't even bring my smoke bombs... Which reminds me of the actual second rule of treasure hunting: "Better safe than sorry!")

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Allow me.
*Rumbling*

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: The ground... it's shaking!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Wait, did the...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Surface of the water... open up?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: This is bad... this is really bad... I'm getting put on the Fatui's blacklist for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Jahoda, you've helped us so much. If they try anything, we'll protect you!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: C'mon, I—I was just kidding! I'm tough, okay... Just haven't had a chance to show off my fighting skills yet. Me, afraid of the Fatui? Not a chance!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I suspect the relic is hidden down below. Jahoda, your commission ends here.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I am truly grateful for everything you've done for us. You don't need to put yourself in any further danger.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'm coming with you.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: This has nothing to do with the commission, or the danger, or whatever... This has already gotten way out of hand, so I'm coming too — end of story!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's blushing...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hey, zip it! Why d'you keep staring... You looking for a knuckle sandwich, or what? C'mon, move it already!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's really deep down here... What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...We're standing on another fragment of the Ancient Moon's Remnants.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: (So this was the source of the kuuvahki I sensed earlier...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what!? So the Fatui had it hidden underwater this whole time? This gigantic thing!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jahoda, you've... been kinda quiet since we got down here...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Wha— Me? Have I? Haha... It's nothing, really...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Ugh, we're doomed... How are we even supposed to get back up from here?)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (My grappling hook's not nearly long enough... and if someone spots us here after all that commotion... we'll be sitting ducks!)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Eek!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! Oh no, that door's opening! Please don't say it's the Fatui...!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (No, please, no! We finally made it here, and we're so close to getting the job done... I didn't risk my neck just to die before I've even had a chance to spend my reward!)
...What happened? Why did the underwater barrier open?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: How could this be...?

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: Huh...? Lauma? And... you guys?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Vilemina... What's going on here?

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: Looks like... there's no point trying to hide it anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: I thought you might come, but I didn't expect to see you here so soon... Forget it, the Moon Marrow isn't here.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: You... joined the Fatui?

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: ...Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...When?

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: ...The day I could no longer bear to live a lie!

dialogues.speaker: Vilemina
dialogues.text: At first, the Fatui wouldn't accept me... But then one of their Harbingers noticed me, and... said she'd give me a chance...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Hmm...? An alarm? Coming from the Experimental Design Bureau?)

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hm... Interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hey, wrap things up and get yourselves ready... Looks like we might be having some guests.

dialogues.speaker: Aarto
dialogues.text: Yes, my Lady...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Perfect timing... this job's been boring me to death. Time to test some hypotheses.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Bosses... I mean, esteemed clients... I mean, generous benefactors... Wait up, c'mon!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Sure you don't wanna consider heading home first and coming back another day...? Nasha Town's that way! You are aware that this is the way to... Ahhhh!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: A little ahead of schedule, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Oh no, it really is a Harbinger this time...!)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Marionette...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you are here, after all! Hand over that relic, right now — it belongs to the Frostmoon Scions!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Mm? You mean that thing your antlered turncoat brought us?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Ha... I have never much cared for trophies given up without a fight. But watching you tear each other apart over it? Priceless.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...I'm not in the mood for warnings today.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Ooh, how frightening. Had I a "tremble" function, I'd have rattled off at least a dozen screws by now.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Or perhaps I've just set my "sense of humor" parameter too high. Were you trying to be funny just now?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: You don't honestly believe you're a match for me... Do you?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Go on, then. Let's serve our guests a little appetizer...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hey, didn't you hear me? I said let's serve our guests a little—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: #...Oh no! Watch out, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: It's the Wild Hunt!

talks.objective: Try to seal the Wild Hunt

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that... it?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whew... At least, that's what the Lightkeepers' handbook says...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Careful! It's not over yet!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (What's going on...? It's Abyssal power alright, and even stronger than before...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (What's the Wild Hunt even after...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon! Lauma! Jahoda!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (No response... I have to find them again, and quickly...)

talks.objective: Find the source of the voice

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: #{M#Aether}{F#Lumine}! Over here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #...! {M#Lumine}{F#Aether}!

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: Quick, grab my hand!

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: #{M#Aether}{F#Lumine}...! What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #...Why are you here at all, {M#Lumine}{F#Aether}?

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: ...What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: #If I may be so bold... What does "family" mean to you, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #...Why were you after the Moon Marrow that night, {M#Lumine}{F#Aether}?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Among those who entered the final chamber, there was either someone with impure intent, or else... an Abyssal presence.

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: We can talk about that later!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Tell me why, {M#Lumine}{F#Aether}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (No... It can't be...)

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: You know, this is only the second time we've fought together since the day we both woke up in Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No...

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: #...{M#Aether}{F#Lumine}?

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: But when I found you, you were still in hibernation. Even the key to the chamber was still secure on your person.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We... didn't wake up together...

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: #What are you talking about? We don't have time for this, {M#Aether}{F#Lumine}!

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: #Look at me, {M#Aether}{F#Lumine}.

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: Don't you want to explore this world with me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Is everyone okay?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whew... Think I saw my life flash before my eyes there. Good thing Lauma Doe was there to save the day...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: #Are you alright, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm fine...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Ha... Well, that took you long enough. Seriously, how many of you are there? Pathetic...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Oh no... I spoke too soon! Totally forgot we still have a Harbinger to deal with!)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, is that... the Moon Marrow! It was hidden inside that big robot of hers all along!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... that robot...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Ugh... That's "Pulonia" to you, not just some "robot"!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...Take it, and get lost.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You're just... giving it to us?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Well, I wasn't the one who put out the order to find this thing in the first place... So if someone wants it, they can help themselves. Maybe even choke on it — see if I care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Is she saying... that it was another Harbinger who was after the Moon Marrow?)

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...So? Are you waiting for me to change my mind, or what? I'd be more than happy to pick up where we just left off... But, I should warn you, I'm in a bad mood right now.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: ...Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Fine by me! Totally, completely, absolutely on board with that!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's... finally over. *sigh* If that doesn't make the "Most Thrilling Commission of the Year," I don't know what will...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Looks like... the Fatui are all gone now... Agh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lauma!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Lauma mentioned that she normally has to keep her power in check. I guess... this is what happens if she doesn't...)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I'm alright... It's just been so long since I truly felt the power of the moon...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Hmm? I thought I sensed the Wild Hunt nearby... Don't tell me... you've already taken care of it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's Flins!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Hey, he's... that Ratnik!)

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Unless I am mistaken... You are the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions, are you not? May I ask... What is that in your hand?

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Please, don't get me wrong. I've been tracking the Wild Hunt lately, and I've come to suspect that its actions... aren't as aimless as they might seem.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: When I saw what you were holding, I could not help but start... connecting the dots.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #(So that night, {M#Lumine}{F#Aether}... No, the Wild Hunt... was using me to get to the Moon Marrow...?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I'd better find some time to have a word with Flins, just in case...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You'd better be extra careful, Flins... It seems like the Wild Hunt is capable of impersonating people now.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Oh, is that so? Funny that — I just showed up completely out of the blue, yet you seem to have no problems trusting me...

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Hahaha... I apologize. I shouldn't be making jokes like that right now.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: Anyway, I understand — thank you for the tip-off. It seems that the Wild Hunt has somehow... changed in nature. I'll have to report this to HQ right away.

dialogues.speaker: Flins
dialogues.text: For now, let us part ways here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There's... still something strange about him that I can't seem to put my finger on...)

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Phew...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Wait, so... Lauma was on her guard against him this whole time?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That little "joke" of his just now... sure scared the bejeebies out of Paimon. Are all the Ratniki in Nod-Krai like that...?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: They're usually stationed in remote areas and tend to keep to themselves. So, uh, it's not surprising they end up a little... eccentric?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: No... He's different.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? How so?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: The animals... they've told me they're afraid to even go near him...

talks.objective: Return to the Curatorium of Secrets

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. I just made you all a pot of tea — better drink it while it's hot.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Boss Nef, you wouldn't believe how scary our day has been! Seriously, I am never, ever taking random jobs like that, EVER again... Ya hear me?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, now! You even faced the Wild Hunt and lived to tell the tale... What's left to be afraid of?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a sec, how did you— Ohhh right, like you told us before... Your business is "dealing in information."

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh? Boss Nef... The teacups... Wh—Why is there one missing? Did you... think I wasn't coming back!?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: My, my... How could you think that of me? You know the rules — if a member of staff wants tea, they pour it themselves. Your cup's sitting safe and sound, right there in the cupboard.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: A... m—member of staff? Does that mean you're... accepting me back!?!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Wasn't that the deal?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Boss Nef! You're the best boss ever!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Heh. You never change, do you? Everything turned out fine, no? You found exactly what you were looking for... yet there you are, sulking away as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Nefer... That medicine we discussed before, the one for congenital kuuvahki sensitivity... I need you to get it for me.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: And how do you expect me to find something like that for you in the middle of the night? You'll have to wait till morning, at the very least.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I need it right now.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, I'll see what I can do. But you know "urgent" means "extra charge," right?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: So... Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: ...Hmm. You know what? You do seem a little... different.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: In a good way, or a bad way?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Mm... Who can say? I'll take it either way, so long as you don't start making a habit of asking me for ridiculous favors...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon... A lot has happened these past few days. I don't know what I would have done without you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, don't mention it! That's what we're here for!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't forget, your family believe and trust in you too.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Mhm, you're right... and tonight, I'm planning on telling them everything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tonight? Isn't it a bit... late already?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: The moon shines brightly this night... What better time for the Frostmoon Scions to usher in a new dawn for truth?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Thank you for your kind words.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: But before I do, there's one more thing we need to deal with...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohhh, yeah... Now that we have the Moon Marrow...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: You'll... have to forgive me... I used too much of my strength in the battle earlier. I fear... I won't be able to help you uncover the truth of the past. Not right away, at least.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's fine! We're going to be in Nod-Krai for a while anyway, so there's no rush, right?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Thank you.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: But there's another problem... How to keep the Moon Marrow safe now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Can't we just return it to your secret chamber?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: The seal has been broken. Even if it were restored... now that the Wild Hunt has gotten in once, there's no guarantee that it won't happen again...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right... Yeah, that makes sense...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Back when the Frostmoon Scions' bloodline still ran strong, in special circumstances, a Moonchanter could act as a vessel, safeguarding the relic within their own body...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: But it is a grueling trial of will and endurance. The Moonchanter who did this... only lasted two days.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: As for me... I might be able to last five, at most.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold on... You'd be using your body as a vessel?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Yes. You can think of it like dropping a red-hot ball of iron into a bucket of water. How long the water lasts... depends entirely on the bucket's size.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: ...Pardon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, that's not a bad idea! You've always held up pretty well against the Abyss... Surely the Moon Marrow can't be any more dangerous than that?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I... It's not at all that I don't trust you, but... it's too risky.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we're out of options, aren't we? Might as well give it a shot.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: ...Alright. Well, I'll be right by your side. If anything feels off, please tell me immediately.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do I need to do?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Here, hold it in your hands.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Feel its power... Imagine you're a lake, a cluster of stars... Let the moon become a part of you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—Whoa! It... went into your body!

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: How was that? Are you feeling any discomfort?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...None at all.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (But... I seem more attuned to the kuuvahki than I was before...)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (When I close my eyes... I can sense something far off, beyond the false sky... So that's the true Frost Moon?)

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Astonishing... Not even the slightest hint of lingering fluctuations. It's as if all that power... just sank to the bottom of the ocean.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Well, looks like we won't have to worry about the Wild Hunt catching its scent now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew, Paimon knew you have special abilities, but still, you never fail to amaze.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: ...Mm? Did I miss something just now?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Yes... and it was nothing short of a miracle...

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Ha, not something I'd be interested in, then. Anyway, here's the medicine you asked for. This is all I've got for today — I'll have someone send the rest over when we have it.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Thank you, Nefer. I really appreciate everything you've done for me.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Please stop being so... nauseatingly friendly. It's creeping me out.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: So... What exactly did you all go through during that Wild Hunt attack? I'd prefer to hear it straight from you.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Hmm... A phantom that can mimic the appearance of others... Quite different from what we've seen before.

choices.text: It disappeared right in front of me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... and both times it appeared, its goal was pretty clear. It seems like it was after the Moon Marrow!

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: ...And on both occasions, it was accompanied by the Wild Hunt too. It appears there must be some close connection between the two.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I must say, I don't often see you look this serious, Nefer.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Too late in the day for thinking, that's all. We'll pick this up again later. You all feel free to keep chatting, though — just don't forget to lock up when you leave.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: #On that note... {NICKNAME}, please keep the Moon Marrow stored within your body for the time being.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: We'll take it back off your hands as soon as the Wild Hunt's been taken care of, once and for all...

choices.text: Sure thing. Trust me, I've got this.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Of course.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Anyway, if the two of you will excuse me... I'm heading back to Hiisi Island now. It's time I came clean with the Frostmoon Scions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, we're coming with you! Though... guess we won't be able to do much more than cheer you on from the sidelines.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: That alone means more to me than you could ever know.

choices.text: Aren't you worried I'll make a run for it?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Ha... Now that's what I'd call a joke.

choices.text: I'm willing to take the risk.
...Maybe I can give it a try?

talks.objective: Accompany Lauma back to Hiisi Island

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Go, go, go... But make sure you stick to the side!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: We should be able to use the terminal to move the drawbridge.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Here's the access card. I'll keep watch while you handle the controls.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: All done. Let's keep moving.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Time to slot in the charging component.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's finally down! Quick, let's hurry down to the lower level before we're spotted!

dialogues.speaker: Sibling
dialogues.text: #{M#Aether}{F#Lumine}...！

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Wait, what was that...?)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: This way leads straight into the armory!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Shh! No chatting while we're sneaking in!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Wait, is that really the route we're going with...? Oh well, too late to turn back now...
